requirement: Target journal must be selected in the AAS portal; current target is The Astrophysical Journal.
action_required_in_m1_6: No scientific change; use ApJ in M1.6 portal/materials.

requirement: Article type is Article for the target submission plan.
action_required_in_m1_6: Carry selected article type into M1.6 submission metadata.

requirement: Use the current AASTeX macro package; AASTeX v7 is the current recommended preparation route.
action_required_in_m1_6: Convert manuscript_v2 into AASTeX v7 in M1.6 without scientific changes.

requirement: Line numbers are mandatory for AAS submissions and revisions.
action_required_in_m1_6: Use the AASTeX linenumbers option in M1.6.

requirement: ApJ abstract must be shorter than 250 words.
action_required_in_m1_6: Preserve scientific content; recheck after AASTeX conversion.

requirement: Current email addresses are required for all authors.
action_required_in_m1_6: Carry confirmed email into AASTeX/portal metadata in M1.6.

requirement: Corresponding author must be correctly identified; author order in portal must match the manuscript PDF.
action_required_in_m1_6: Carry exact confirmed author order and corresponding-author flag into M1.6.

requirement: Each author requires complete affiliation/postal metadata for manuscript preparation.
action_required_in_m1_6: Use affiliation `Independent Researcher, Spain`; do not invent or publish a personal postal address.

requirement: Submission requires title, abstract, and authors to be entered in the portal.
action_required_in_m1_6: M1.6 will transfer frozen title/abstract and confirmed author metadata.

requirement: Submission requires selection of a topical corridor in addition to the journal.
action_required_in_m1_6: Choose the best current corridor at submission; do not alter science.

requirement: Select between 1 and 12 Unified Astronomy Thesaurus (UAT) concepts.
action_required_in_m1_6: Select UAT concepts in M1.6 from the frozen manuscript content.

requirement: References must be formatted correctly for AAS journals.
action_required_in_m1_6: Generate AAS-style BibTeX from the same eight works in M1.6; do not add scientific references.

requirement: Submission files, including images and tables, must be at one directory level; upload system cannot parse folders/subdirectories.
action_required_in_m1_6: Build a flat submission-source bundle in M1.6.

requirement: Graphics must be properly prepared and documented.
action_required_in_m1_6: Reuse M1F01–M1F05 without scientific regeneration; adapt file packaging only.

requirement: Digital assets must be identified and described.
action_required_in_m1_6: Create explicit submission digital-asset manifest/data-code statements in M1.6.

requirement: If astronomy archive datasets were used, the portal asks for archive dataset DOI/citation information.
action_required_in_m1_6: Resolve appropriate TESS/MAST dataset citation/DOI metadata in M1.6 without altering scientific claims.

requirement: Provide financial information and indicate requested discounts/support and charge allocation among authors.
action_required_in_m1_6: Resolve actual APC support/discount/payment route at portal/production stage.

requirement: Provide funder information if the work was supported by grants or sponsorship.
action_required_in_m1_6: Render exact confirmed funding statement in M1.6.

requirement: Authors must read and acknowledge AAS professional and ethical standards.
action_required_in_m1_6: Read/acknowledge current standards during final portal preflight; no manuscript science change.

requirement: Choose whether to opt in to dual-anonymous review.
action_required_in_m1_6: Submit without dual-anonymous review.

requirement: If dual-anonymous review is selected, identifying information must be removed from review files and a cover letter with authors/affiliations/acknowledgements is required.
action_required_in_m1_6: No anonymous review-copy transformation is required; cover letter remains an editorial asset.

requirement: Author contribution statement is optional in AASTeX v7 but supported and must be agreed by all authors if used.
action_required_in_m1_6: Render confirmed contribution roles in M1.6 using current AASTeX contribution environment or equivalent.

requirement: Software relevant to the paper should be clearly accessible/cited; persistent archiving is strongly recommended.
action_required_in_m1_6: Prepare code availability statement and exact archive links/versions in M1.6.

requirement: Non-table/figure data should use an appropriate third-party repository and be linked/cited; source code is preferably persistently archived rather than embedded as a ZIP in the article.
action_required_in_m1_6: Map frozen project assets to repository citations/statements in M1.6.

requirement: AAS journals are Gold Open Access under CC BY 4.0; 2026 ApJ charges are quantum-tiered.
action_required_in_m1_6: Budget/waiver decision remains author administrative input; no role in scientific selection.

requirement: 2026 ApJ Tier 1 is $1,425 for <=30 quanta; final quanta are determined in production.
action_required_in_m1_6: Do not treat rough pre-submission quanta as binding; confirm final financial route with authors.

requirement: Authors may identify individuals they consider conflicted and inappropriate as referees.
action_required_in_m1_6: Carry `NONE` unless the author changes this before portal submission.

requirement: Suggested reviewers were not identified as a mandatory field in the retrieved official AAS pre-submission checklist.
action_required_in_m1_6: Recheck live portal in M1.6; do not invent a requirement.

requirement: Preprints are compatible with AAS publication; however, authors seeking dual-anonymous review are advised not to post to arXiv/social media before review.
action_required_in_m1_6: Prepare an arXiv/preprint package in M1.6; public sharing is compatible with the explicit DAR=NO choice.

requirement: AAS uses the submission portal to collect journal/corridor, manuscript files, author metadata, ethics, digital assets, financial/funder metadata and UAT concepts.
action_required_in_m1_6: Use this checklist as the portal preflight in M1.6.
